sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.detail: one sentence, from memory, written before document work
sections.markdown: What I believe the market narrative is: a low-growth, family-controlled auto-parts supplier with thin float and thin coverage — priced as a cyclical at a high-single-digit P/E and a fat yield, with the replacement-parts annuity and 30% ROE treated as an artifact of the cycle.

sections.heading: Earnings-quality gate
sections.markdown:
- **Accruals ratio (NI−CFO)/avg assets:** FY2023 −3.8%, FY2024 −2.6%, FY2025 +0.0% — cash-backed. The 9M-2026 filing breaks the run: CFO Rp590.6bn against group profit Rp958.3bn (62% conversion), a ~38% accruals gap. Optics-class.
- **Cash conversion (CFO/NI):** 118%, 112%, 100% (FY23–25); 62% in 9M-26.
- **Divergence:** inventories Rp1,610.3bn vs Rp1,250.3bn (+28.8%); third-party receivables Rp1,304.8bn vs Rp1,173.3bn (+11.2%) while revenue grew 6.74% — 1.66x revenue growth, the card's trigger. Optics-class.
- **IDX regime:** main board; no special notation surfaced; FY audited, Q1–Q3 unaudited.
- **Related-party:** purchases 8.48% of consolidated COGS (8.07% prior); related-party sales Rp58.7bn. Disclosed, stable, not arm's-length-verifiable. Optics-class.
- **Structure:** no pledge, rights-issue or auditor-tier signal in the pack; controller 50.54% [F59].
- **Classification:** no manipulation-class flag. Two optics-class flags (working-capital build, related-party) → haircut in the pre-mortem, not a pass.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** SMSM is a low-float, family-controlled, no-growth auto-parts cyclical. At Rp1,640 it pays 7.6x FY2026E and a 9.5% gross yield; the reverse DCF implies revenue contracting ~6.3%/yr from FY2027 — the market is applying close to double the house cost of capital, or pricing a melting ice cube.

**Why wrong:** 85% of revenue is recurring aftermarket [F53], exported to 125+ countries [F52]; filters are consumables tied to the vehicle parc, not new-car sales. 9M-2026 revenue +6.7% and profit +6.7%, domestic +16.2% [F74/F75/F81]; ROE ~29.5%; net cash; 72% payout with 21 consecutive years of increases [F88]. The discount is liquidity and control, not a demonstrated earnings decline. A 9.5% yield on a net-cash, 29%-ROE business is the mispricing.

**What proves us wrong:** 2027 H1 overseas growth below domestic for two quarters (restocking reversal), gross margin below the recent band for a full year, a related-party purchase-ratio step-up, or a payout cut toward the 45% policy floor [F18].

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. The working-capital build is real: inventories +28.8% and third-party receivables +11.2% (1.66x revenue growth) while 9M CFO fell to Rp590.6bn against Rp958.3bn profit [F29/F41/F96/F27/F25] — earnings quality is deteriorating even as the P&L grows.
2. Growth is thin and margin-assisted: revenue CAGR FY2022–25 is ~2.9% (4,894.2→5,338.8) and the FY2025 EBIT margin of 28.1% is 5.6pp above FY2022's 22.5% — the base case holds a peak margin [dossier income statement / derived ratios].
3. Exports are 62% of revenue but grew only +1.64% in 9M-26 versus domestic +16.21% off a weak base [F97/F81/F82] — the recovery is domestic and base-effect-driven, not broad.
4. Control and float: PT Adrindo Intiperkasa holds 50.54% [F59]; free float 40.95% and ADTV Rp6.1bn — a controlled, mid-liquidity name can stay discounted for years (the house de-rating base rate).
5. Related-party purchases of 8.48% of COGS [F32] are disclosed and stable, but a controlled issuer's minority has limited ability to verify arm's-length pricing.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is 2029 and this position lost 30%. The most likely reason is the value trap: the 40.95% float and 50.54% controller kept the discount in place while the working-capital build (inventories +29%, receivables 1.66x revenue) absorbed the cash the dividend needs, forcing a payout cut toward the 45% policy floor — and the "cheap" 7.6x turned out to be the market correctly pricing a low-float, low-growth, related-party-exposed name. Secondary: the export restocking reversed in 2027 H1 (overseas was already +1.6%) and the 28.1% EBIT margin mean-reverted. A kill exit at Rp1,200 fills lower under the 25% ARB band.

sections.heading: IDX microstructure
sections.markdown: Free float 40.95%; controller PT Adrindo Intiperkasa 50.54% at 30-Sep-2026 [F59]; no pledge, HSC listing or special notation found. Real liquidity: 30d ADV Rp6.08bn (house 3m Rp5.69bn); a 10%-NAV position (Rp1.5bn) is ~25% of ADV and exits in ~1.2 days at 20% participation — inside the 7-day limit. At Rp1,640 the ARA/ARB band is 25% (Rp1,230 / Rp2,050 next session); tick Rp5; board lots of 100. Limit entry Rp1,630, max chase 3% → Rp1,679. Flows stale (`fund record` `{}`); no flow narrative underwritten.

sections.heading: Macro stance
sections.markdown: **AGAINST** the memo's INDO rate-sensitive / consumer-discretionary AVOID tilt: funding-leg pressure (IDR 18,003.5 through a 13% oil fall) is a real headwind for domestic demand and the discount rate, but SMSM is 62% export/dollar-linked with net cash, so transmission is muted; I mark AGAINST honestly and do not size above the cap.

sections.heading: Valuation and ev_math
sections.markdown: Entry Rp1,630 is a valuation level: ~7.9x FY2026E EPS and an 8.0% net dividend yield. Target Rp2,370 is the base DCF. Kill Rp1,200 (~5.8x FY2026E, below every auto-parts trough) is where the market would be pricing terminal impairment — a fundamental falsification, not a stop; ROE <15% and payout <40% are the KPI kills. up 45.4%, down −26.4%, ratio 1.72 vs the archetype's library 1.67. p_up held at the 0.40 registry prior — no deviation, the bear is a live near-market scenario. Own Kelly 19.5% vs library 13.3%; the gap is the entry discount to intrinsic value, itemised. Dividends credit the up leg only (8.0%/yr × 3 years); fee/tax drag 1.0% (0.15 buy + 0.25 sell + 0.10 final tax + 2×25bp slippage); EV +10.9%.

sections.heading: House coverage reconciliation
sections.markdown: My FY2026E/27E EPS of 207.4/221.2 matches the house model's 209.7/221.2 within 1%; the divergence is valuation, not earnings. The house blends DCF 3,089 (50%), P/E 2,041 (30%) and EV/EBITDA 1,806 (20%) to a Rp2,668 base and ~Rp2,700 target on an 11.85% WACC, 4% terminal g and a ten-year explicit forecast. I use a 12.5% COE and a three-year explicit horizon, so my base of Rp2,370 is ~11% below the house. My bear (Rp1,690) is far below the house bear (Rp2,355): the house's mirrored shocks still leave every scenario above the market price, while I let the de-rated multiple persist and the EBIT margin fall to 25% — I think the house understates the de-rating risk that is the actual reason the stock is at 7.6x. My target is ~12% below house; I do not underwrite the house's 49% terminal-value share.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
**BEAR — DREW — 2026-11-07.** Fact-check: 9M revenue 4,182.8 / EBIT 1,172.3 / NI 874.1 are the sums of the 2026-03/06/09 quarters (dossier lines 52-54); net cash 907 = 1,080.1 − 173.0 (lines 32-33); payout 71.7% (line 45); shares 5,758.7m (line 35). No fabricated load-bearing input found.

**1. [FATAL] The cash bridge is the trade.** 9M-26 CFO Rp590.6bn is 20.7% below 9M-25's Rp744.4bn (F27: "590,593 744,414") while profit rose 6.6%. The Rp2,370 base implies FCFE ~Rp994bn (NI 1,194 less ~200 capex, zero WC drag). Applying FY2025's own Q4 reversal (1,124 less 744 = 380) gives FCFE ~765, DCF ~Rp1,861, and EV -1.6% at the thesis's own p/down. Fragile — single-assumption dependency: the 45% upside is a WC normalisation the filing contradicts.

**2. [MATERIAL] Stale cheapness.** "7.6x and 9.5% gross" are the house's FY2026E multiples at Rp1,595 (fund record: PE 7.6045, yield 9.468%, price 1595), not 1,640. At 1,640: 7.82x and 9.21% (7.91x/8.84% on the thesis's own EPS/DPS).

**3. [MATERIAL] Overstated pessimism.** -6.3% is the house engine's solve at 1,595 inside a 10-year model with a 49% TV share (coverage_doc reverse_dcf -0.063349). On the thesis's own three-year DCF, 1,640 implies roughly zero perpetual growth; zero-growth value is ~Rp1,540-1,615, today's price. The market prices no growth, not a melting ice cube; the 45% is the growth premium.

**4. [MATERIAL] Growth.** 6% base vs a 2.9% FY22-25 CAGR and overseas +1.6% (the thesis's own fact 3). At 3% the DCF is ~Rp2,130.

**5. [MATERIAL] ARB gap.** The method card says assume a kill fills 15-35% below the level; a 1,020 fill (-37.4%) makes Kelly -25%. down_pct is not ARB-adjusted, so the size is not either.

**6. [MATERIAL] Kills below the falsifiers.** Payout <40% is under the 45% policy floor the thesis itself names (F18); price 1,200 is 29% below its own bear DCF 1,690, so -26.4% is a sentiment tail, not the falsification level. Conservative direction, but it does not describe the risk.

**7. [MATERIAL] Base rate/sleeve.** derated_compounder_rerating (0.40, n=15) is defensible, but its note mandates the multiple-survival test with market-share data — never run. The sleeve is COVERAGE (idea card), no base rate exists, and fund record is absent, so no sleeve hit rate is checkable.

**8. [MATERIAL] Pre-mortem gap.** The house report names the channel: a weaker rupiah makes imported competing parts cheaper and compresses the domestic margin (fund record:144). The thesis calls transmission "muted" on export/net-cash grounds and ignores the 38% domestic leg.

**9. [MINOR] The idea card's three sharpest questions — missing survival test, mischaracterised reverse DCF, no scenario to price — are unanswered.**

**Stop objecting:** Rp1,450 (7.0x FY2026E, 10.0% gross), where my cash- and growth-haircut target (~Rp1,860) still clears ~4% EV; at 1,630 the honest EV is ~0.

**Verdict: MAJOR_REVISION.** The FATAL is in the payoff construction, not the franchise; it clears at Rp1,450 or a ~Rp1,860 target.

**VOSS (RISK_OFFICER), 2026-11-09T13:08:22+07:00**

**Factor-tag audit — FAIL-CLOSED, un-buyable.** SMSM.JK is absent from `the INDO universe` (97 tickers; zero matches for SMSM or Selamat). `factor`/`factor2` are therefore absent/UNTAGGED, and the `the fund rules factor_taxonomy` rule VETOes a buy whose universe factor is absent/UNTAGGED/off-list. The business is real (filters/radiators, 85% aftermarket, 62% exports, net cash), so the fix is the missing row, not the thesis: add SMSM.JK tagged `domestic_cycle` / `idr_defensive`, matching the closest listed peer AUTO.JK (domestic_cycle/idr_defensive) and the conservative higher-stress primary (-5%). Separately, `the sizing engine` did NOT fail closed on the missing row: it returned a 10% recommendation and a +0.5pp heat contribution at the 10% anchor, consistent with a -5% factor it should not have had. That silent default is a process defect to route to PENDING_PATCHES.

**Stress / size.** Post-trade stress-day book loss = **1.8% NAV** (`book_heat_after_pct`; computed at the script's 10% anchor — at the Judge-fraction 5% the SMSM term halves and heat is ~1.55%). Remaining headroom: **6.2pp to the -8% REVIEW trigger** and **13.2pp to the -15% DEGROSS trigger** (10.2pp to the 12% heat budget; `book_heat_warn=false`). Current indicative drawdown -1.84%; governors read official marks only.

**Liquidity.** Full intended position at the Judge fraction = 5.00% NAV = **Rp757.9m**; at 20% ADV participation on the 30d ADV of Rp6.08bn this is **0.62 days to exit** (0.67d on the 3m Rp5.69bn; 12.5% of one day's ADV). The full 10% script position is 1.25d. Both inside the 7-day limit; `liquidity_cap_pct` 55.94 is not binding.

**Sizing audit.** script_pct = recommended_pct = **10.00% NAV** (hard_max 10.00; binding constraint constitution_cap; kelly_quarter 13.1; liquidity cap 55.94). Judge 0.5 fraction -> pm_pct **5.00% NAV**, so pm_pct <= script_pct holds. The 0.5 binds, and it is load-bearing twice: it halves 10% to 5%, and 5% is exactly `max_single_trade_pct_nav` (5.0) — the PM cannot take the 10% anchor in one ticket without breaching that cap. Thesis `sizing:` is still null; PM must record {script_pct: 10.0, pm_pct: 5.0, deviation_reason: "Judge PASS_REDUCED 0.5"}. ARB tail: the stated down -26.4% is the Rp1,200 fill; a second ARB band to ~Rp1,020 is -37.4%, i.e. -1.87% NAV at 5% vs -1.32% stated (delta -0.55pp NAV) — survivable, but down_pct is one band, not two.

**Kill-criteria hygiene.** All four machine-monitorable: price <1,600 (review) and <1,200 (exit_full) on the price feed; ROE <15 and payout_ratio <45 on FY audited LK (named source). No vague criterion; no bounce-back. Residual: the two KPI kills are annual, so deterioration can run up to a fiscal year before a machine trigger — the price kills are the interim monitor.

**Horizon balance.** SMSM is `horizon: long`; the book is 4 names / 19.21% gross, below the 8-name ramp threshold and 60% deployment, so `min_short_horizon_theses: 2` / `min_long_horizon_theses: 2` is WARN-advisory and not yet binding. No short-horizon thesis is evidenced in this packet; if the book ramps, the long tilt becomes a stated WARN gap. Stated, not forced.

**Concentration in disguise.** Under the peer-consistent domestic_cycle primary tag, post-trade same-primary exposure = ERAA 4.36% + JPFA 4.80% + SMSM 5.00% = **14.16% NAV**, below the 40% soft / 60% hard factor caps — no VETO. The untagged overlap is real: SMSM, MEDC and PTBA are all weak-IDR/export-revenue beneficiaries (post-trade 15.04% NAV), while ERAA and JPFA are weak-IDR import-cost victims; SMSM bridges the domestic-consumer sleeve in a demand shock and the commodity/USD sleeve in a rupiah shock. No shared balance sheet, controller, customer or lender with the existing four; net cash differentiates it.

**Output contract: ESCALATE.** Grounds: (1) SMSM.JK has no `the INDO universe` row, so factor/factor2 are UNTAGGED and the closed-taxonomy VETO makes the name un-buyable at any size until the row is added; (2) the constitution-level conflict is that the Judge stamped PASS_REDUCED and `the sizing engine` recommended 10% on an absent tag instead of failing closed — the data hole and the silent default must be repaired before any ticket; (3) on the arithmetic alone the trade is otherwise clean (5% NAV, 0.62d exit, 1.8% heat, 6.2pp/13.2pp governor headroom, pm_pct <= script_pct) and can clear at 0.5x once SMSM.JK is tagged and the sizer is re-run.
